changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE tag_metric_link ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, tag_id BIGINT NOT NULL, metric_name_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_tag_metric_link_tag_metric_name UNIQUE (tag_id, metric_name_id), CONSTRAINT fk_tag_metric_link_tag FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag (id), CONSTRAINT fk_tag_metric_link_metric_name FOREIGN KEY (metric_name_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_tag_metric_link_tag ON tag_metric_link (tag_id); CREATE INDEX idx_tag_metric_link_metric_name ON tag_metric_link (metric_name_id);
